A big thank you to all the staff who fully deserve the 5 stars.

A Story from an Allergy Sufferer...

I've had allergies since I can remember. I'm usually very sensitive to everything from air and dust to seafood...

As soon as the rainy season starts, the symptoms appear. It's just like the weather forecast... haha

During the rainy season, it's even worse; it happens every day...

When I exercise enough and get enough rest, the symptoms improve a little...

I used to live with allergy medication constantly. I'm tired of taking it... haha

Sometimes, I have shortness of breath and need injections or inhalers...

Then I discovered the immune-boosting vitamins administered intravenously at Phatthana Krabi Medical Clinic. My life has improved so much...

I don't have to take allergy medication every day anymore...

Initially, I had vitamin drips every 2-3 weeks. Later, it became every 4-5 weeks. It's easy. The drips take time... Each vitamin session only takes 30-45 minutes...

Life is so much easier now. Most importantly, I don't have to take allergy medication anymore...

Now... I've even forgotten where I put my allergy medication... haha

The joy of having allergies is not having to take allergy medication... haha

If you have allergies, I highly recommend this place...
Initially, the doctor will examine you and assess the medication needed.
There's a team of doctors and nurses to take care of you throughout the vitamin drip...
The staff are lovely and the service is excellent.

There are private rooms for you to relax in...

Oh... and the nurses here are very gentle... hehe

Don't wait until you're sick to treat it. Preventative measures by boosting your immunity are better than waiting. Life is 100% happier now.
